— °- nāṭaka , n. , or ~ā, f. , a group of junior dancing girls, of concubines; ; Ja V 279, 10 (paṭhamaṃ tāva ekaṃ sattāhaṃ ~aṃ dhammanāṭakaṃ katvā vissajjetha, sace sā puttaṃ labhissati sādhu, noce atha majjhimanāṭakaṃ vissajjetha); — °- niddesa , cūḷaniddesa, m. , see sv niddesa ; — (cūḷa)- nipphāva , m. , a kind of pulse ; Sp 836, 7 (~-pupphaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cūḷhanippāva-, prob. wr ); — °- pati , cūḷapati, m. , a brother-in-law ; ( nom. ~ā; acc. ~araṃ; instr. ~arā; gen./dat. ~u, ~uno, ~ussa; voc. ~a; iic °-pitu-, °-piti-), one’s father’s brother, an uncle; an elder male relative ; Ja I 387, 25 (cullamātarā ~arā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cūḷa-); II 5, 26 (matā bhātā bhaginī cullamātā ~ā ti sabbe pi ñātakā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be cūḷa-); 393, 7 (āyasmato [Rāhulassa] … ~ā Anandatthero pitā sammāsambuddho, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se cūḷa-); III 456, 9 (rājā … amhākaṃ ṭhānantaraṃ mama ~ussa dassatī ti, Se so; Be cūḷa-; Ce, Ee petteyyassa); Mil 204, 17 (Sāriputto anekesu jātisatasahassesu bodhisattassa pitā ahosi mahāpitā ahosi ~ā ahosi bhātā ahosi …, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be cūḷa-); Sp 7, 5 (Sakyakulappasuto cāyaṃ āyasmā [Ānando] tathāgatassa bhātā cūḷapituputto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cūla-); 470, 9 foll.
